name: Partner rewards (draft)
defaults_applied: The guidelines didn't say whether colleagues who already have a license count; we assumed they don't.
The guidelines didn't say whether shares outside the company need an admin's OK; we assumed they do.
open_questions: By "teammates", do you mean colleagues on the same company email domain, or anyone in a shared space, including contractors and guests from other companies?
What counts as using the product "in a meaningful way": signing up, completing a first agent action, or staying active for several weeks?
Should shares with partners earn the bonus only once the sharer's company has an enterprise agreement, or at any time? How much larger is the bonus?
